propositions: A plan edited mid-review still runs every remaining LLM pass and only fails at sign time when own_material differs, wasting all billed work after the edit.
A run-scoped cancel token and own-material probe should cancel the review at the two between-pass seams (verify_inputs and coach_inputs) when the ticket's own material changes.
The cancel predicate must be scoped to OWN material only — comparing tracker HEAD, relation snapshot, or related_material would reintroduce the d70a false-cancel regression.
The cancel signal must be an out-of-band token checked before gate_dispatch's coach/verify recovery paths, else a cancel would be recovered into a findings verdict and signed.
A cancelled review yields an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with a plan-review-cancelled-stale finding, no sidecar emit, and CLI exit code 2, returning before any signing code.
The probe reads under local_read_context so it never fetches, reconverges, or takes the sync lock, and fails open (unknown/None fingerprint does not cancel).
